# `side::kick()`: A coding agent for RStudio

[`side::kick()`](https://simonpcouch.github.io/side/reference/kick.md)
is a coding agent for data science in RStudio, implemented entirely in
R. It can interact with your files, talk to your active R session, and
run code.

![A screencast of an RStudio session. A script tool-fetch_skill.R is
open in the editor. A call to \`side::kick()\` in the console launches a
non-blocking shiny chat app in a full-height viewer pane. The user then
pastes a snippet of code into the chat dialog and says 'refactor this
into a helper'. After calling multiple tools to locate the code, the
chat app proposes two file edits in a git diff-based UI that refactor
the code as
desired.](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/33e8d2bb-2e9e-4ff2-aef8-1695aaca3c77)

> \[!Caution\]
>
> This project is highly experimental.
>
> I put this app together to give myself a first pass at implementing
> several bits of functionality I’d like to see in ellmer/shinychat/btw.
> This package will not go to CRAN. Ideally, from here, more and more of
> the functionality prototyped in this app can make its way into
> ellmer/shinychat/btw, done “the right way,” and ported back into this
> app.

## Installation

To get started, install with:

``` r
pak::pak("simonpcouch/side")
```

Then, run
[`side::kick()`](https://simonpcouch.github.io/side/reference/kick.md).
You might place
[`side::kick()`](https://simonpcouch.github.io/side/reference/kick.md)
in your `.Rprofile` (perhaps with `usethis::edit_r_profile()`) to launch
[`side::kick()`](https://simonpcouch.github.io/side/reference/kick.md)
every time you start R.

[`side::kick()`](https://simonpcouch.github.io/side/reference/kick.md)
is intended for use with RStudio’s *Sidebar*, a full-height pane that’s
currently only available in [RStudio
Dailies](https://dailies.rstudio.com/). Install RStudio, then search for
“Sidebar” in the command palette.

## Features

[`side::kick()`](https://simonpcouch.github.io/side/reference/kick.md)
can:

- **Use any LLM** supported by
  [ellmer](https://ellmer.tidyverse.org/)–Anthropic, OpenAI, Google
  Gemini, OpenRouter, and even local models are fair game.
- **See your active R session** to explore your computational
  environment.
- **Use tools** to read and write files, run shell commands, and read R
  documentation.
- **Create and execute plans**, allowing it to take on longer-horizon
  tasks.
- **Persist state** across R sessions so that you can close RStudio and
  come back to a chat later.
- Respond to **interrupts** so that you can stop execution and reroute
  the agent.
- Read **skills**, markdown files that describe how to carry out a given
  task in the way you need it to.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

*[`side::kick()`](https://simonpcouch.github.io/side/reference/kick.md)
is implemented with [btw](https://posit-dev.github.io/btw/),
[ellmer](https://ellmer.tidyverse.org/), and
[shinychat](https://posit-dev.github.io/shinychat/).*
